name: X01_also_sin0
description: CRF pulse also raises AAF STREAM_INPUT 0

name: X02_also_sin_last_aaf
description: CRF pulse also raises AAF STREAM_INPUT N-1 (the CRF row's neighbour)

name: X03_misroute_to_n_minus_1
description: CRF pulse delivered at STREAM_INPUT N-1 INSTEAD of N

name: X04_also_sout_n
description: CRF pulse also raises STREAM_OUTPUT N (the CRF Media Clock Output)

name: X08_also_avb_as_ix1
expectation: RED: nor any tuple of another type or index
description: CRF pulse also raises AVB, and the arbiter hands AVB out as {AVB_INTERFACE, 1}

name: X09_crf_as_foreign_type
expectation: RED: STREAM_INPUT N only / another type
description: the CRF row handed out as type 0x000E (not STREAM_INPUT) at index N

name: X10_crf_at_undeclared_n_plus_1
description: the CRF row handed out as STREAM_INPUT N+1 (undeclared)

name: X11_crf_at_index_plus_64
expectation: RED: STREAM_INPUT N only / another index
description: the CRF row handed out as STREAM_INPUT N+64 (past the harness bitmap)

name: X13_dirty_source_removed
expectation: RED: bind edge on nxn; every [NOTIFY-CRF] incl. A's copy
description: the CRF row's Table 5.22 source tied off

name: X14_pending_clear_below_crf
description: the pending-clear loop stops below the CRF row

name: X12_also_sout_n_late200
description: CRF pulse also raises STREAM_OUTPUT N, but 200 cycles later (outside the 64-step window)

name: H3_flip_a_copy
expectation: RED: only [NOTIFY-CRF] ...and so is A's copy
description: flip one counters-block bit of controller A's logged CRF push before the A-copy check

name: H1_no_other_record
expectation: with X08: expected GREEN (shows the fifth record is load-bearing)
description: observer drops a tuple none of the four records can hold (round-1 behaviour)

name: H2_instrument
description: print each arbiter delivery inside the bind-edge window with its step number, and uns_log size/capacity around the [NOTIFY-CRF] solicited exchange
